decision_rule: As in poles rounds 3-5, ships and mining checkers A/B. Corrected: the value (or the plants.csv field that rests only on it) adds a fact the cited page does not show, tags a judgement or a company/brand-level fact as stated at the plant of a multi-site company, ties a posting to the plant through a location shared by several sites, misapplies a coordinator counting rule, restates an announced agreement as completed, or the quote is not on the page (raw source checked before calling a JSON-LD quote missing). Confirmed: the cited page, or for a multi-row claim a sibling row's page opened 2026-11-16, carries every additive clause. Opening lines: every clause carried by a stated row of a claim named in the reasoning or that row's page; closing question in the second person ('you'); no pitch language. Scope (headline denominator): every stated row of the 10 plants in name, address, city, state, parent_company, products, weld_processes, materials, certifications, part_size_fit, production_type, existing_robots, welder_postings, triggers, headcount, relationship; every row of any tag of a claim cited by a score_* row (weld_processes, part_size_fit, production_type, welder_postings, triggers, headcount, parent_company); and the 10 opening_line rows.
error_rate_note: 13/166 = 7.8%. Denominator: 110 stated, 33 unknown and 13 inferred evidence rows plus 10 opening lines. All 171 quoted rows (in scope and wider set) matched their pages (0 missing, 0 unreachable). Substantive (a fact misplaced or a rule misapplied): 3 (Ground Force parent rests on a 2021 agreement-signing release; Mayville count ignores ruling 5; Klein Jacksonville line presupposes plant-level tank builds). The other 10 are attribution: 8 company-level product rows tagged stated at plants of multi-site companies and 1 product row quoting posting boilerplate, plus 1 form-only line fix (closing question without 'you'). No score component changes. Wider set (out of headline): 1/57 corrected (Ground Force tier tagged stated).
repeated_kinds: quote does not support value (11). Fetched today with tools/fetch_page.py (plain request plus raw source, browser fallback): all 63 distinct source URLs behind the 223 rows of the 10 plants (166 in scope, 57 wider). Every quote was matched against normalised text plus raw source, with '...' fragments checked separately: all found.

- One WebSearch was used for discovery (Ground Force open or closed); no search text was used as a quote. One EDGAR full-text search returned no hits.
- Every corrected_quote was re-checked with --check today.
- evidence_row = 0-based CSV record index + 2.
